summary: All 20 requirements verified: 12/12 MUST passed, 5/5 SHOULD passed, 3/3 MAY passed.

M2.title: GET returns value or ERR key_not_found
M2.evidence: _cmd_get checks existence (including expiry), returns value or 'ERR key_not_found'.

M3.title: DEL removes key, ERR key_not_found if missing
M3.evidence: _cmd_del deletes key and expiry, returns 'OK' or 'ERR key_not_found'.

M4.title: KEYS lists all keys terminated by END
M4.evidence: _cmd_keys returns active keys newline-separated, ended with 'END'; empty store returns 'END' only.

M6.title: EXISTS returns TRUE or FALSE
M6.evidence: _cmd_exists returns 'TRUE' if key present and not expired, 'FALSE' otherwise.

M7.title: FLUSH clears all keys, returns OK
M7.evidence: _cmd_flush clears both self._data and self._expiry, returns 'OK'.

M8.title: OK for successful SET and DEL

M9.title: ERR unknown_command for unrecognized commands
M9.evidence: execute() returns 'ERR unknown_command' for empty input, unknown commands, and malformed commands with wrong arg count.

M12.title: Maximum stored keys enforcement (ERR store_full); updates allowed
M12.evidence: _cmd_set checks capacity only for new keys; existing keys can be updated at capacity. _cleanup_expired() runs before capacity check.

S1.title: MSET atomic bulk set, returns OK <n>
S1.evidence: _cmd_mset validates all pairs (key length, value size, capacity) before committing atomically; returns 'OK {len(pairs)}'.

S2.title: MGET bulk get, NIL for missing, terminated by END
S2.evidence: _cmd_mget returns value or 'NIL' per key, terminated by 'END'.

S3.title: TTL returns remaining seconds, -1, or ERR key_not_found
S3.evidence: _cmd_ttl returns remaining TTL as int, '-1' for no expiry, 'ERR key_not_found' for missing keys.

S4.title: SETEX sets key with expiry; expired keys treated as non-existent
S4.evidence: _cmd_setex stores expiry timestamp; _is_expired() used in GET, EXISTS, DEL, KEYS, COUNT to treat expired keys as non-existent.

S5.title: APPEND appends or creates, returns OK <new_length>
S5.evidence: _cmd_append appends to existing value or creates new key; returns 'OK {len(new_value)}'; enforces value size limit.

Y1.title: RENAME renames key, returns OK or ERR key_not_found
Y1.evidence: _cmd_rename preserves value and expiry during rename; returns 'ERR key_not_found' if old key missing.

Y2.title: TYPE returns STRING/INTEGER or ERR key_not_found
Y2.evidence: _cmd_type uses int() to distinguish INTEGER from STRING; returns 'ERR key_not_found' for missing keys.

Y3.title: DUMP returns all key=value pairs terminated by END
Y3.evidence: _cmd_dump formats as '<key>=<value>' per line, terminated by 'END'; filters expired keys.

notes: Implementation uses proper two-phase atomic validation for MSET (validate-then-commit).
Expiry cleanup is lazy (on access) with explicit _cleanup_expired() before capacity checks.
Command dispatch uses .upper() for case-insensitive command matching.
